name: Reincarnated as a Sword Brave Rush
storyline:
An adventure fantasy where a man is reborn as a sword in another world and teams up with Fran, a Fluffy-Eared Girl seeking freedom.
Together with the legendary sword known as “Teacher,” Fran hones her swordsmanship and magic, taking on powerful foes.
With intense battles and a heartwarming bond between the two, the story has captured fans through light novels, manga, and anime alike!
summary:
Reincarnated as a Sword Brave Rush is the official browser game adaptation of the hit anime Reincarnated as a Sword — a roguelike RPG now playable on G123, free to play with no registration or download required.
Take on dungeons as Fran and her sentient blade Teacher, battling through waves of enemies while crafting your own ultimate build. Combine and upgrade skills and equipment to create a playstyle that's uniquely yours — every run brings new possibilities.
Jump in instantly from any browser, on PC or smartphone. Reincarnated as a Sword Brave Rush brings the action-packed world of the original anime to life in a fast-paced, free-to-play roguelike built for fans and newcomers alike.
